label: Tanec · minutový s hudbou
desc: Klasická minutová scéna (stabilní podoba tváře) s jednou souvislou skladbou přes celé video.
desc_en: The classic one-minute preset (stable facial likeness) with one continuous piece of music across the whole video.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

scenes.name: intro
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo

beats.prompt: the dancer breathes gently, chest rising once, then blinks slowly and opens their eyes again, and ends perfectly still
a warm smile slowly spreads across their face with a small tilt of the head, and the dancer ends holding the smile
the dancer starts to sway their hips gently side to side, arms loose and relaxed, feet in place, and ends mid-sway with weight centered

scenes.name: main
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: the dancer steps to one side and shifts their weight onto that leg while both arms rise to shoulder height, and ends there
the dancer turns halfway away from the camera and back again in one smooth motion, hair swinging with the turn, and ends facing the camera
the dancer raises both arms above their head as their hips sway, head tilting once to each side, and ends with arms up
the dancer lowers their arms slowly while rolling their shoulders back, hips still swaying, and ends with hands on their hips
the dancer steps to the other side, weight shifting, one arm sweeping across their body, and ends with that arm extended
the dancer spins once on the spot, hair swinging, and ends facing the camera with arms relaxed at their sides

scenes.name: finale
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, one slow continuous movement, calm steady tempo

beats.prompt: the sway slows to a stop, the dancer exhales and lets their shoulders drop, and ends standing still
the dancer tucks a loose strand of hair behind their ear and looks at the camera, a smile forming, and holds
the dancer laughs softly, eyes creasing, then settles into a warm steady gaze at the camera and stays still

soundtrack: the dancer dances joyfully to the beat. Upbeat pop dance music with a clear steady rhythm, warm bass line and catchy synth melody.
